description: This PHP class defines a filter parameter object for searching employment status records within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class, allowing for specifying sorting options and a name filter for employment status entities.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering employment status search results, including sorting and name filter options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter object with default sorting by 'es.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter.
